svg.text: Stage 6 — Full program
LEARN
A condition uses Running to prevent
overlapping sequences.
WHAT TO ADD
Wrap the existing handler body in if not
Running. Set true before waving and false
after the final tick.
PREDICT
Will touching during a wave start more
waves?
OBSERVE
Touch once: ten cycles begin.
Touch while busy: no extra cycle starts.
After the tick, touch to run ten again.
EXPLAIN
Why must Running become false at the end?
Use a micro:bit V2 and a 360-degree
positional servo on Nezha S2. The simulator
can show events and LEDs; confirm movement on
the physical build. Adjust the linkage to its
working range.
